config.logodds_margin_scope: numerical validation only; never exclude subjects from CE or clinical summaries

stage_a_R2_definitions.per_dim_gain: 1 - SSE_conditional / SSE_P2; relative prediction SSE reduction
stage_a_R2_definitions.per_dim_R2_gain: (SSE_P2 - SSE_conditional) / TSS_TD; additive conventional R2 gain

config.scale_decomposition_order: unclipped change = mean-change at target scale + scale-change at source mean; clipping remainder separate

source_read_findings.model/mm_gtunets.py: VAE reparameterizes at eval and reloads saved weights; joint16, classifier Linear16-256/ReLU/BN/Linear2 once. Attention tensor reconstruction detaches scores; RP and 1x1 compatibility forward retain .data projection.
source_read_findings.model/gtunet.py: Two modality-specific GTUNets restore all nodes; F.dropout without training argument remains stochastic at eval.
source_read_findings.model/rp_graph.py: return remains inside phenotype loop; categorical motivation edges retain historical behavior.
source_read_findings.train_mm_gtunets.py: Historical x=feature_selection(x,...) overwrites features across folds; classifier optimization uses CE plus graph loss.
source_read_findings.opt.py: Output dimension16, hidden128, scores SITE_ID/SEX/AGE_AT_SCAN; original defaults retained in historical experiment.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/normative.py: Train PCA32; trainTD Ridge10 on intercept/age/age2/additive sex; fivefold crossfit; per-dimension TD OOF residual scale floor0.25; clip[-4,4]; tenth-neighbor density gate; joint partition-site permutation v2.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/pcnd.py: Frozen 1089-parameter Linear32-32/GELU/Linear32-1; zero final initialization; delta=.25*tanh(net(d))*g; adds [delta,-delta] to logits.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/run.py: Historical train_one jointly optimized core+branch; strict best validation CE+graph checkpoint; saved full epochs. frozen_one stored same-core counterfactuals and five seeds; branch has no sampling.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/analyze.py: Audited get_fold(P0), fold-then-seed aggregation, CE sign, mean-draw probability metrics and input checks. No import or call of this historical runner.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/config.json: Registered P6 revision is partition_within_site; repeats only P4/P5/P6; all hyperparameters historical and read-only.
source_read_findings.experiments/PCND_20261016/report.md: Prior formal and auxiliary results used only as historical records and numerical cross-checks; new Stage A/B statistics recomputed independently.

paper.finding: MRRL aligns FC/RFE and VAE phenotype latents, AMRS and multimodal similarity build population graph; dual GTUNets and attention feed MLP. Table5 ABIDE ACC imaging/nonimaging/both76.49/52.00/82.92; AUC85.22/50.28/88.21. Existing phenotype contribution does not establish extra normative patient-level complementarity.

phenobrain.finding: Primary ICML2026 abstract describes phenotype-conditioned multi-hop routing and phenotype-guided attention; simple conditioning is not a first-use claim. No head-to-head experiment or full novelty proof performed.

initial.RNG_pairing_limit: P0/P4/P5 saved five seed identifiers match SHA policy. P0 has no saved full RNG states in this bank; equal seeds do not prove identical backend consumption or identical stochastic realizations across trained models.

implementation_revision.reason: Historical MAD was float32; independent float64 mean differed by1.7486643101409516e-12. Added exact legacy-dtype crosscheck; kept primary float64 and all reference/branch tolerances unchanged.

tests.name: ASD probability direction and threshold tie
P4 unit gate has zero gate attribution
P4 P5 equality detects altered input
crossfit query cannot fit itself and overlap is detected
871 subject OOF coverage rejects duplicate missing subject
manual rescue2 harm2 each draw and net accuracy identity
deterministic branch delta invariant across native stochastic draws
independent rank AUC with ASD0 and tied probabilities

limitations: Historical supervised RFE contamination and transductive population graph remain; train-only normative references do not make the full pipeline leakage-free.
Three seeds and five draws repeat the same871 people, not independent clinical cohorts.
Reference TD OOF feature prediction, diagnostic complementarity, and medical causality are separate questions.
P0 and P5 are independently trained cores; matched inference seed identifiers do not prove matching full random-state consumption.
P4/P5/P6 are separately jointly trained; only within-checkpoint counterfactuals identify direct frozen branch interventions.
PCA mean-difference retention is a descriptive training-set direction and may reflect site/age distributions or RFE contamination.
No diagnostic threshold, reference model or hyperparameter selected on test data; this remains posthoc research attribution.

verdict.claim_supported: No established patient-level phenotype-conditioned diagnostic complementarity in this version. Reference fit, input change, MLP response and CE benefit must be distinguished.
remaining_alternatives: Predictable age-related variation need not be incremental ASD information beyond the multimodal core.
Small delta may reflect redundant or noisy diagnostic evidence, regularization, low-dimensional representation or joint optimization; frozen attribution does not identify a unique training cause.
P0 and P5 have different trained core checkpoints and stochastic paths; their core CE difference is associated with training, not a pure causal optimization effect.
Per-dimension scale changes and clipping contribute to deviation changes; a change in d does not measure only reference mean change.
Low reference prediction gains can coexist with measurable query sensitivity; neither alone proves useful normative disease information.
verdict.MICCAI2027: Current evidence does not establish a successful new method. Basic phenotype conditioning overlaps existing work including PhenoBrain; no first-use novelty claim.
verdict.one_next_experiment_only: Independently preregister a leakage-free, site-held-out conditional-increment test of simple TD deviation evidence added to a fixed existing core; verify unique diagnostic information before designing a new fusion module.
